name: Zhejiang Jingxing Paper Joint Stock Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Jingxing Paper Joint Stock Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of paper products in China and internationally. The company offers kraft liner boards, white top linerboards, bobbin base papers, corrugated base papers, virgin pulp thissue paper, recycled tissue paper, corrugated cardboards, paper boxes, and other specialty papers. Additionally, it provides pinse tissues. It also offers household paper products under the Jingxing brand name. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Pinghu, China.
